- आयुष्मान खुराना और सारा अली खान की फिल्म Udta Teer ने रिलीज के बाद बॉक्स ऑफिस पर हैरान करने वाली कमाई की है। 🚀
- Sacnilk की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक, फिल्म ने बुधवार को दो करोड़ छत्तीस लाख रुपये का कलेक्शन किया और कुल कमाई तैंतीस करोड़ छब्बीस लाख रुपये तक पहुंच गई है। 💰
- ट्रेड एनालिस्ट तरण आदर्श के मुताबिक, फिल्म को डिस्काउंट टिकट ऑफर और BOGO ऑफर का फायदा मिला है जिससे आंकड़े स्थिर रहे हैं। 🎟️
- फिल्म में आयुष्मान एक पाकिस्तानी जासूस के रोल में हैं जो ब्लास्ट के बाद अपनी याददाश्त खो बैठता है और खुद को काउंटर-टेररिज्म स्क्वाड ऑफिसर समझने लगता है। 🕵️‍♂️

ctx.title: Udta Teer box office collection day 8: Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan film refuses to slow down, crosses  ₹33 crore so far
ctx.summary: The spy comedy opened to positive reviews. It marks the directorial debut of Akash A Kaushik.
ctx.text:
Ayushmann Khurrana and Sara Ali Khan ’s Udta Teer has had a surprising box office haul in the first few days of release. It opened to positive reviews and stood its ground despite the mammoth box office pull of Rajinikanth's Jailer 2. But, that momentum has slowed down considerably as the film entered its second week.
Udta Teer surpassed expectations and collected ₹ 4.10 crore on its opening day in theatres. It opened to decent reviews, which helped its cause and the film gradually showed growth on Saturday to collect ₹ 7.25 crore. Sunday showed more growth, at ₹ 8.20 crore. It is the highest single-day haul of the film so far. The dip started on Monday, as expected, but the film stayed steady.
As per the latest update on Sacnilk, Udta Teer has managed to collect ₹ 2.36 crore on Wednesday. It is slightly above last day's haul which was at ₹ 2.25 crore. This brings the total India collection to ₹ 33.26 crore . The film has to remain steady in the upcoming days, before the big release this Diwali in the form of Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana.
Taran Adarsh also pointed at the box office performance of Udta Teer and wrote on X, “Udta Teer remains on par with Monday on Tuesday, with the discounted ticket offer boosting footfalls... The #BOGO ticket offer today [Wednesday] should help the numbers remain stable. The *Week 1* total is expected to be around ₹ 31 cr [+/-] – a fair result... The film has one more week to make the most of its theatrical run, starting this Friday, before #Ramayana arrives next Thursday [5 Nov].”
The film follows a Pakistani spy, played by Ayushmann Khurrana, who loses his memory after a blast and begins to believe that he is an Indian Counter-Terrorism Squad officer. His mistaken identity sets off a chain of comic and action-packed events as he becomes caught up in a cross-border espionage operation.
The film also stars Rahul Bose, Ram Kapoor, Suhail Nayyar, Gulshan Grover, late Mukul Dev, Raghubir Yadav, Brijendra Kala, Supriya Pilgaonkar and Sandeep Anand in supporting roles. The project marks the fourth collaboration between Karan Johar's Dharma Productions and Guneet Monga-led Sikhya Entertainment after The Lunchbox, Kill and Gyaarah Gyaarah.
Santanu Das is a Senior Content Producer at Hindustan Times with over 5 years of experience, writing on films, pop culture and film festivals. He has a keen interest in writing about South Asian independent films and has covered several film festivals, including Sundance and CPH: Docx. He also brings a sharp perspective to the monthly column called The Fault in Our Stars, where he writes about a recent film/series and what stops the ‘good’ from becoming ‘great’.

A gold medalist from Banaras Hindu University, Santanu completed his postgraduate studies in English from Jadavpur University. He is also a Rotten Tomatoes-certified film critic. When not watching films or speaking to celebrities, Santanu can be found reading a book. Some of his favourite films are Aparajito, Ponyo and The Double Life of Veronique. His favourite books include The Corrections, The God of Small Things and A Room of One's Own.

Santanu continues to write passionately about films and celebrity culture. He brings a relatable, as well as critically informed, lens to entertainment and culture for a wide audience.
